notes: ai-fanout.com was newly registered by Matthias Ramahi for this project.
The canonical English and German homepages present Native Fanout as the primary mode and the live modelled Search Ideas generator as a clearly separate secondary mode.

/library and /de/lernen each contain eight comprehensive, paired guides with reciprocal hreflang annotations. OpenAI, Gemini, citations, query-fanout SEO and broad AI-search SEO have distinct reader jobs; four narrower routes per language permanently redirect to their intent-equivalent guide.

/methodology and /de/methode explain the direct OpenAI/Gemini native-search contract and the separate modelled-ideas boundary. Manual comparison and research routes are retired from public IA, noindex and excluded from the sitemap.

/examples and /de/beispiele contain four paired, dated evidence pages backed by one normalized OpenAI observation fixture. The former OpenAI-vs-Gemini promise is now titled as a local comparison protocol and does not publish retained Gemini Grounded Results.

The sitemap is generated from the validated central route registry. It includes only canonical indexable 200 routes, uses explicit EN/DE/x-default alternates, and assigns editorial lastmod dates only after meaningful page changes. Build or deploy time is never used as a page lastmod.
The API is enabled only when CAPTCHA, atomic quota, cost and provider secrets plus both explicit public flags are configured.
Unknown paths return a real 404 and are not redirected to the homepage.
